executedQueries.label: approved_stored_observations
executedQueries.sql: WITH links AS (SELECT DISTINCT video_id FROM youtube_artist_video_links WHERE artist_key=ANY($1::text[]) AND active=true AND confidence_score>=80), selected AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.video_id,(s.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date) s.video_id,s.observed_at,s.view_delta FROM youtube_video_intraday_shadow_snapshots s JOIN links l ON l.video_id=s.video_id WHERE s.source_type='youtube_api_shadow' AND s.view_count IS NOT NULL AND s.view_count>=0 ORDER BY s.video_id,(s.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,s.observed_at DESC), grouped AS (SELECT video_id,count(*)::int points,min(observed_at)::text first_observation,max(observed_at)::text latest_observation,count(view_delta)::int deltas FROM selected GROUP BY video_id) SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM links) eligible_videos,count(*)::int trusted_observed,count(*) FILTER (WHERE points>=2)::int multi_date,coalesce(sum(points),0)::int selected_points,count(*) FILTER (WHERE deltas>0)::int videos_with_deltas,min(first_observation) first_observation,max(latest_observation) latest_observation FROM grouped

executedQueries.label: approved_stored_observations
executedQueries.sql: WITH links AS (SELECT DISTINCT video_id FROM youtube_artist_video_links WHERE artist_key=ANY($1::text[]) AND active=true AND confidence_score>=80), selected AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.video_id,(s.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date) s.video_id,s.observed_at,s.view_delta FROM youtube_video_intraday_shadow_snapshots s JOIN links l ON l.video_id=s.video_id WHERE s.source_type='youtube_api_shadow' AND s.view_count IS NOT NULL AND s.view_count>=0 ORDER BY s.video_id,(s.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,s.observed_at DESC), grouped AS (SELECT video_id,count(*)::int points,min(observed_at)::text first_observation,max(observed_at)::text latest_observation,count(view_delta)::int deltas FROM selected GROUP BY video_id) SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM links) eligible_videos,count(*)::int trusted_observed,count(*) FILTER (WHERE points>=2)::int multi_date,coalesce(sum(points),0)::int selected_points,count(*) FILTER (WHERE deltas>0)::int videos_with_deltas,min(first_observation) first_observation,max(latest_observation) latest_observation FROM grouped
